About me

I'm an avid cellist with over 10 years of experience. I've participated in symphonies, ensembles and solo performances nationally, and was an All-State cellist in high school. My teaching is inspired by the Suzuki method, and I love adding to my repertoire in learning new techniques. Now, I'm looking to grow my experience as a teacher by helping all aspiring cellists further their own talents at an affordable price in a friendly environment!

What I teach

  • Foundations: posture, bow hold, shifting
  • Beginner repertoire & note-reading
  • Developing tone, rhythm, and basic music theory
  • Audition & recital preparation for early-level pieces
